## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added to RogaScan.

## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? What use cases does it address?

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of how you would like this feature to work.

## Alternatives
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Would You Like to Implement It?
- [ ] Yes, I'd like to implement this feature
- [ ] No, I'm just suggesting it

If yes, please mention your experience level:
- [ ] Beginner (learning)
- [ ] Intermediate (some experience)
- [ ] Advanced (experienced developer)

---

**Note**: This is an open-source project for education/research. Feature requests that align with educational goals are prioritized!
